title: Fixed #36724 -- Removed broken 'for' attribute from the legend tag
description:
#### Trac ticket number

ticket-36724

#### Branch description

~~The `FilteredSelectMultiple` widget (initialized by `SelectFilter2.js`) has a `<legend>` with a `for` attribute that points to the field's original `id` (e.g., `for="id_groups"`).~~

~~This patch fixes the issue by assigning the original `field_id` (e.g., `id_groups`) to the main wrapper `div` (`selector_div`) that the script creates. This gives the `<legend>` a valid element to point to, resolving the broken link.~~
